description: This source file defines and registers a set of styles for the CKEditor rich text editor. It adds a style set named 'default' with definitions for block styles, inline styles, and object styles including custom headers, marker spans, font styles, and image/object formatting.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.stylesSet.add
methods.description: Method to register a new style set with CKEditor, associating it with the name 'default' and providing an array of style definitions.
